title: Simply (better than) Vanilla.
description: "Simply (better than) Vanilla" is a modpack aimed at adding the BEST way to play Minecraft.
body:
Minecraft Just Got A Lot Better.

"Simply (better than) Vanilla" is a modpack that add's onto what vanilla is missing, without adding crazy things.

All mods work on servers (client side).

**All MODS AND WHAT THEY DO:**

3D Skin Layers: Makes Outer Skin Layer 3D.

Ambient Environment: Adds Subtle Noises.

Better Command Block GUI: Reworks Command Block GUI.

Better Ping Display: Displays Ping In Miliseconds.

Chat Heads: Shows Head Of User Next To Their Chat Message.

Cherised Worlds: Favorite Worlds In World Selection Menu.

Chunky: Pre-Loads Chunks.

Command Books: Run Commands Through Books (Creative Only).

CME: Less Lag Well Loading Chunks.

Continutity: Connected Textures.

Dynamic FPS: Reduces FPS While Minecraft Is Not Open.

Entity Culling: Hides Off Screen Mobs.

Essential Mod: QOL Features.

FPS Reducer. Reduces GPU And CPU Usage While Minecraft Is Minimized.

FabricSkyboxes: Custom Skybox Support.

Fullbright Toggle: Hotkey Toggles Fullbright.

Immediately Fast: Fast Chunk Rendering.

ImmersiveThunder: Realistic Thunder Sound Physics.

Indium: Server Preformance Booster.

Iris Shaders: Shader Support.

Lithium: Fast Rendering.

Midnight Controlls: Controller Support.

MinecraftCapes: Add Custom Made Capes.

Mod Menu: Adds A Confiable Mod Menu.

NRPW: Remove Resource Pack Warnings.

Noisium: Adds Texture Noise To Grass.

Not Enough Animations: Subtle Third Person Animations.

Replay Mod: Record And Edit Replays.

Shulker Box Tooltip: See Inside Shulkers From Inventory.

Reese's Sodium Options: Reworks Sodium Menu.

Smooth Menu: Uncaps Menu FPS Limit.

Sodium: FPS Booster.

Sounds: Adds Hotbar Sounds.

Symbol Chat: Allows For Emoji's and Fonts To Be Used In Chat.

Throughout Keybinds: Change ALL In Game Keybinds.

Vectorientation: Stretch And Squish Falling Blocks.

Wakes: Adds Water Wakes.

World Edit: Ability To Change World With Commands (Creative Only).

Xaero's World Map: World Map Of All Places You've Been.

Zoomify: Zoom Support.

EMF + ETF: Custom Entity Textures + Animation Support.
